title: Squirtle Zenigame Pokemon Babanuki Old Maid Card, Japan Center
descriptionText:
Pokemon Japanese - Squirtle (Zenigame) - from "Pokemon Babanuki" (ポケモンババ抜き), the official Pokemon Center Old Maid card game, released 2019.

- Pokemon: Squirtle / Zenigame (ゼニガメ)
- From: Pokemon Babanuki - Old Maid card game, original 2019 Pokemon Center release (Gengar is the "Joker" card in this set)
- Language: Japanese
- Single card from the deck, sold individually

Condition: No visible print defects or wear. Front and back are both photographed - please judge for yourself from the images, as they are of the actual card you will receive.
